capabilities: Chat with an AI model in a right-sidebar panel
Answer questions using vault content via vector index with keyword-search fallback
Show simplified source references with open buttons
Store and invoke prompt templates from a prompt file or folder
Run prompt workflows such as daily reviews and batch prompts
disambiguation: Not just a prompt runner; it is a full chat assistant with vault retrieval, though prompts and batch runs are a major part.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README marks building the vault vector index as optional and untested, and its section on local embeddings on phones is unclear (apparently requires the same embedding model on PC and phone).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat that can retrieve vault content as context or store reusable prompt templates for repeated workflows.
summary: AI assistant plugin that adds a chat sidebar with vault search and RAG answers, a prompt library, and batch prompt runs.
